ablation: age-only maturity curve across all currently liquid assets, without re-entry or transition-churn information
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: 2016-2022 reused research/development; 2025+ previously viewed diagnostics; live excluded
cost_hypothesis: episode metadata changes slowly; weekly rebalance with off-cycle exits limits churn
failure_mode: re-entry history adds nothing beyond simple age-since-entry or trend
falsifier: rotate episode-age/re-entry/churn metadata across sorted asset labels while preserving current membership
portfolio_role: eligibility-state satellite distinct from price-only alpha
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Mechanism selected from the repository frontier before performance inspection; current campaign does not use public performance claims.
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats base development score; no automatic promotion
thesis: Stable recent re-entrants near a finite eligibility maturity age outperform freshly unstable or repeatedly crossing members; non-re-entrant episodes are excluded from the primary mechanism.
timing: historical is_liquid state through the current completed day; episode age capped at 126 days; no future membership
validation: 2023-2024 only after freeze; never drives mutation
